title: Spontaneous comfort you can enjoy again
meaning: A shared domestic idea brings lasting joy when an easy beginning does not leave its continuation without clear participation from both.
text: Home can come alive through mutual choice: hearing a wish, trying something new together and arranging pleasure for two. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe open participation. The Fool in energy tests your footing through starting without necessary conditions: do it first and work things out afterwards. The Sun in emotions enjoys a visible result in which you recognise shared life. Yet bright initial pleasure does not always become comfort if continuation needs unnoticed preparation and a successful trial leaves maintenance unexplained.

For example, you make a small corner for breakfast together. The first morning delights, but then you discover that possessions must be moved and dishes found every time. **The joy of a shared beginning deserves conditions for peaceful repetition.** Some permanent space makes the pleasant idea part of your routine. The visible result no longer depends solely on an inspired push, and care includes the next ordinary day without the same enthusiasm for novelty.

The difficulty is judging the idea only by its first impression’s brightness. When repetition takes work, joy seems gone and another idea necessary. Home fills with beginnings without familiar continuation. Warmth becomes more dependable when spontaneous participation can agree simple conditions and ordinary care is not considered a dismissal of what worked so well the first time. The good result can then stay available to you both.
